title: Hooks

body.text: commands that run automatically when an event happens
— like PostToolUse running after Claude edits a file (auto-format the code), or PreToolUse checking before a command runs. Set them in settings.json.

example: "A popular hook: after every Edit, run prettier --write on that file — so AI code always matches the team's format"

title: Hooks teams actually use

body.text: auto-format after edits · log all bash commands for audit · block dangerous commands
— hooks make rules automatic and systematic, not reliant on the AI's or a person's memory.

example: "PreToolUse hook: if a command contains 'rm -rf' or 'drop table', block it and warn immediately"
